mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases do not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decreases do not correlate with improved corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over the past three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increases do not correlate with corporate revenue growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases do not correlate with improved corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, the combined signal of high interest rates and rising inflation leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the past month and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, the combined signal of strong job growth and a tightening labor market leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past two months signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decreases do not correlate with broader economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals an economic contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 negative growth does not correlate with negative returns.
